messages:
Carlos Mendes: Heading to family in Omaha this weekend — driving I-80 from DSM. Any recs for roadside diners/breakfast stops that aren't sketch? Prefer local spots, good coffee. ETA around 10:30am Saturday. Thanks!
Anya Patel: Love Blue Plate in Council Bluffs — old-school menu, great pancakes. 10-15 min off I-80 exit 48. :pancakes:
Kevin Liu: If you want something smaller, stop at 'The Grain Bin' in Glenwood. Amazing breakfast sandwiches. Not many seats though. `Open 7am`
Dani R: Pro tip — avoid the chain near exit 50, it's always crowded. Also Harry's Diner in Missouri Valley has huge portions. https://maps.app.goo.gl/example
FoodieBot: Suggested route stop: Main Street Diner — rating 4.6, avg wait 12 mins
Carlos Mendes: @Anya thanks! Blue Plate looks perfect. Anyone know if they take cards? I try to avoid cash-only.
Anya Patel: They do cards. Tip: bring cash for tip jars. :)
Kevin Liu: If you're into pie, Harry's has blackberry pie. Massive.
Dani R: If your timing shifts to later, `Omaha Biscuit House` on 72nd is great but 30 min detour.
Anya Patel: snapped a pic of the pancake stack last time — worth it :camera_with_flash:
